शंकरप्रेरितः शीघ्रं तदा चक्रे स भस्मसात् ॥ 11 ॥
पुरत्रये देववरेण तेन विनिर्मितेऽभूज्जगतां प्रहर्षः ॥
जग्मुस्तदा देवगणाः प्रहष्टाः स्थानानि राजेन्द्र तथा स्वकानि ॥ 12 ॥
1.181.m:
one obtains desired wishes—there need be no doubt about this. / And whoever constantly recites this hymn of yours, O Lord of Gaṇas,
to him also you will always be the giver of all desires.”
Nāḍāyana said:
Having been thus praised by Śaṃkara, the glorious Vināyaka
brought the three cities together in one place without hindrance. / Once the three cities were united, Viṣṇu, situated on the tip of the arrow and released from the bow, / propelled swiftly by Śaṃkara, reduced them to ashes.
When the three cities were destroyed by that foremost of gods, great joy arose in the worlds. / The hosts of gods, overjoyed, then returned to their own abodes, O king of kings.

1.182.s:
1.226
.. nāḍāyana uvāca .. ..
tasyaiva devadevasya śṛṇu karmedamuttamama ..
āsīddaityondhako nāma bhinnāñjanacayopamaḥ .. 1 ..
1.182.d:
1.226
॥ नाडायन उवाच ॥ ॥
तस्यैव देवदेवस्य शृणु कर्मेदमुत्तमम ॥
आसीद्दैत्योन्धको नाम भिन्नाञ्जनचयोपमः ॥ 1 ॥
1.182.m:
Nāḍāyana said:
Hear this supreme deed of that very god of gods. / There was a Daitya named Andhaka, resembling a heap of split collyrium,

1.182.s:
tapasā mahatā yuktastvavadhyaśca divaukasām ..
sa kadācinmahādevaṃ pārvatyā sahitaṃ prabhum .. 2 ..
1.182.d:
तपसा महता युक्तस्त्ववध्यश्च दिवौकसाम् ॥
स कदाचिन्महादेवं पार्वत्या सहितं प्रभुम् ॥ 2 ॥
1.182.m: endowed with great asceticism and invulnerable to the gods. / Once, seeing the lord Mahādeva together with Pārvatī

1.182.s:
krīḍamānaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā hartuṃ devīṃ pracakrame ..
tasya yuddhaṃ tadā ghoramabhavatsaha śaṃbhunā .. 3 ..
1.182.d:
क्रीडमानं तदा दृष्ट्वा हर्तुं देवीं प्रचक्रमे ॥
तस्य युद्धं तदा घोरमभवत्सह शंभुना ॥ 3 ॥
1.182.m: sporting, he set out to abduct the goddess. / A terrible battle then took place between him and Śambhu.

1.182.s:
rudravarṇavinirbhede rudhirādandhakasya tu ..
aṃdhakāśca samutpannā śataśotha sahasraśaḥ .. 4 ..
1.182.d:
रुद्रवर्णविनिर्भेदे रुधिरादन्धकस्य तु ॥
अंधकाश्च समुत्पन्ना शतशोथ सहस्रशः ॥ 4 ॥
1.182.m: Upon being pierced by Rudra's weapon, from the blood of Andhaka / there arose hundreds and thousands of Andhakas.

1.182.s: teṣāṃ ca dāryamāṇānāṃ rudhirādapare punaḥ .. 5 ..
1.182.d: तेषां च दार्यमाणानां रुधिरादपरे पुनः ॥ 5 ॥
1.182.m: And as they were being cleaved, from their blood again others

1.182.s:
babhūvuraṃdhakā ghorā yairvyāptamakhilaṃ jagat ..
evaṃ māyāvinaṃ dṛṣṭvā devadevastadāndhakam .. 6 ..
1.182.d:
बभूवुरंधका घोरा यैर्व्याप्तमखिलं जगत् ॥
एवं मायाविनं दृष्ट्वा देवदेवस्तदान्धकम् ॥ 6 ॥
1.182.m: arose—terrible Andhakas by whom the entire world was pervaded. / Seeing Andhaka possessing such magical power, the god of gods then,

1.182.s:
pānārthamaṃdhakāsrasya sasṛje mātarastathā ..
māheśvarīṃ tathā brāhmīṃ kauberīṃ cānalīṃ tathā .. 7 ..
1.182.d:
पानार्थमंधकास्रस्य ससृजे मातरस्तथा ॥
माहेश्वरीं तथा ब्राह्मीं कौबेरीं चानलीं तथा ॥ 7 ॥
1.182.m: in order to drink the blood of the Andhakas, created the Mothers: / Māheśvarī, Brāhmī, Kauberī, Analī,

1.182.s:
sauparṇīmatha vā yavyāṃ śākrīṃ vai nairṛtīṃ tathā ..
saurīṃ saumyaṃ śivāṃ dūtīṃ cāmuṃḍāmatha vāruṇīm .. 8 ..
1.182.d:
सौपर्णीमथ वा यव्यां शाक्रीं वै नैरृतीं तथा ॥
सौरीं सौम्यं शिवां दूतीं चामुंडामथ वारुणीम् ॥ 8 ॥
1.182.m: Sauparṇī, Vāyavyā, Śākrī, Nairṛtī, / Saurī, Saumyā, Śivadūtī, Cāmuṇḍā, Vāruṇī,

1.182.s:
vārāhīṃ nārasiṃhīṃ ca vaiṣṇavīṃ ca lalatthikām ..
śatānandāṃ bhagānandāṃ picchilāṃ bhagamālinīm .. 9 ..
1.182.d:
वाराहीं नारसिंहीं च वैष्णवीं च ललत्थिकाम् ॥
शतानन्दां भगानन्दां पिच्छिलां भगमालिनीम् ॥ 9 ॥
1.182.m: Vārāhī, Nārasiṃhī, Vaiṣṇavī, Lalatthikā, / Śatānandā, Bhagānandā, Picchilā, Bhagamālinī,

1.182.s:
balāmatibalāṃ raktāṃ surabhīṃ mukhamuṇḍikām ..
mātṛnandāṃ sunandāṃ ca viḍālīṃ śākunīṃ tathā .. 1.226.10 ..
1.182.d:
बलामतिबलां रक्तां सुरभीं मुखमुण्डिकाम् ॥
मातृनन्दां सुनन्दां च विडालीं शाकुनीं तथा ॥ 1.226.10 ॥
1.182.m: Balā, Atibalā, Raktā, Surabhī, Mukhamuṇḍikā, / Mātṛnandā, Sunandā, Viḍālī, Śākunī,

1.182.s:
revatīṃ ca mahāraktāṃ tathaiva pilipicchikām ..
jayāṃ ca vijayāṃ caiva jayantīṃ cāparājitām .. 11 ..
1.182.d:
रेवतीं च महारक्तां तथैव पिलिपिच्छिकाम् ॥
जयां च विजयां चैव जयन्तीं चापराजिताम् ॥ 11 ॥
1.182.m: Revatī, Mahāraktā, Pilipicchikā, / Jayā, Vijayā, Jayantī, Aparājitā,

1.182.s:
kālīṃ caiva mahākālīṃ kāladūtīṃ tathaiva ca ..
subhagāṃ durbhagāṃ caiva karālīṃ dehanīṃ tathā .. 12 ..
1.182.d:
कालीं चैव महाकालीं कालदूतीं तथैव च ॥
सुभगां दुर्भगां चैव करालीं देहनीं तथा ॥ 12 ॥
1.182.m: Kālī, Mahākālī, Kāladūtī, / Subhagā, Durbhagā, Karālī, Dehanī,

1.182.s:
aditiñca ditiñcaiva mālinīṃ mṛtyumeva ca ..
karṇamoṭīṃ tathā yāmyāṃ ulūkīṃ ca ghaṭodarīm .. 13 ..
1.182.d:
अदितिञ्च दितिञ्चैव मालिनीं मृत्युमेव च ॥
कर्णमोटीं तथा याम्यां उलूकीं च घटोदरीम् ॥ 13 ॥
1.182.m: Aditi, Diti, Mālinī, Mṛtyu, / Karṇamoṭī, Yāmyā, Ulūkī, Ghaṭodarī,

1.182.s:
kapālīṃ vajrahastāṃ ca piśācīṃ rākṣasīṃ tathā ..
bhuruṇḍīṃ hāṅkarīṃ caṇḍāṃ śaivāṃ ca kaṭakīṃ tathā .. 14 ..
1.182.d:
कपालीं वज्रहस्तां च पिशाचीं राक्षसीं तथा ॥
भुरुण्डीं हाङ्करीं चण्डां शैवां च कटकीं तथा ॥ 14 ॥
1.182.m: Kapālī, Vajrahastā, Piśācī, Rākṣasī, / Bhuruṇḍī, Hāṅkarī, Caṇḍā, Śaivā, Kaṭakī,

1.182.s:
ghaṃṭāṃ sulocanāṃ dhūmrāmekavālīṃ kapālinīm ..
viśālāṃ daṣṭikāṃ śyāmāṃ trijaṭīṃ kukuhaṃ tathā .. 15 ..
1.182.d:
घंटां सुलोचनां धूम्रामेकवालीं कपालिनीम् ॥
विशालां दष्टिकां श्यामां त्रिजटीं कुकुहं तथा ॥ 15 ॥
1.182.m: Ghaṇṭā, Sulocanā, Dhūmrā, Ekavālī, Kapālinī, / Viśālā, Daṣṭikā, Śyāmā, Trijaṭī, Kukuhā,

1.182.s:
vināyakīṃ ca vaitālīmunmattāṃ śubhanāṃ tathā ..
siddhiñca lelihānāṃ ca kekarāṃ gardabhīṃ tathā .. 16 ..
1.182.d:
विनायकीं च वैतालीमुन्मत्तां शुभनां तथा ॥
सिद्धिञ्च लेलिहानां च केकरां गर्दभीं तथा ॥ 16 ॥
1.182.m: Vināyakī, Vaitālī, Unmattā, Śubhanā, / Siddhi, Lelihānā, Kekarā, Gardabhī,

1.182.s:
tarkaṭīṃ bahuputrāṃ ca pretayānāṃ viṭaṃpurām..
krauñcīṃ sūkaramukhīṃ ca vitatāṃ saramāṃ danum .. .. 17 ..
1.182.d:
तर्कटीं बहुपुत्रां च प्रेतयानां विटंपुराम्॥
क्रौञ्चीं सूकरमुखीं च विततां सरमां दनुम् ॥ ॥ 17 ॥
1.182.m: Tarkaṭī, Bahuputrā, Pretayānā, Viṭaṅpurā, / Krauñcī, Sūkaramukhī, Vitatā, Saramā, Danu,

1.182.s:
uṣāraṃbhāṃ pinākāṃ ca lalitāṃ citrarūpiṇīm ..
svadhākārāṃ vaṣaṭsvāhāṃ dhṛtiṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ kapardinīm .. 18 ..
1.182.d:
उषारंभां पिनाकां च ललितां चित्ररूपिणीम् ॥
स्वधाकारां वषट्स्वाहां धृतिं ज्येष्ठां कपर्दिनीम् ॥ 18 ॥
1.182.m: Uṣā, Rambhā, Pinākā, Lalitā, Citrarūpiṇī, / Svadhākārā, Vaṣaṭ, Svāhā, Dhṛti, Jyeṣṭhā, Kapardinī,

1.182.s:
māyāvicitrarūpāṃ ca kāmarūpāṃ vaśaṃgamām ..
svakaṃbilāṃ siñjikāṃ ca mahānāsāṃ mahāmukhīm .. 19 ..
1.182.d:
मायाविचित्ररूपां च कामरूपां वशंगमाम् ॥
स्वकंबिलां सिञ्जिकां च महानासां महामुखीम् ॥ 19 ॥
1.182.m: Māyā, Vicitrarūpā, Kāmarūpā, Vaśaṃgamā, / Svakambilā, Siñjikā, Mahānāsā, Mahāmukhī,

1.182.s:
kaumārīṃ rocanāṃ bhīmāṃ sadāhāsāṃ madoddhatām ..
āraktākṣīṃ kālakarṇīṃ bharttukarṇīṃ mahāsvanīm .. 1.226.20 ..
1.182.d:
कौमारीं रोचनां भीमां सदाहासां मदोद्धताम् ॥
आरक्ताक्षीं कालकर्णीं भर्त्तुकर्णीं महास्वनीम् ॥ 1.226.20 ॥
1.182.m: Kaumārī, Rocanā, Bhīmā, Sadāhāsā, Madoddhatā, / Āraktākṣī, Kālakarṇī, Bhartṛkarṇī, Mahāsvanā,

1.182.s:
keśinīṃ śikhinīṃ lambāṃ piṃgākṣīṃ lohitāmukhīm ..
ghaṇṭāravāṃ ca daṃṣṭrālāṃ locanāṃ kācajaṅghikām ..21 ..
1.182.d:
केशिनीं शिखिनीं लम्बां पिंगाक्षीं लोहितामुखीम् ॥
घण्टारवां च दंष्ट्रालां लोचनां काचजङ्घिकाम् ॥21 ॥
1.182.m: Keśinī, Śikhinī, Lambā, Piṅgākṣī, Lohitāmukhī, / Ghaṇṭāravā, Daṃṣṭrālā, Locanā, Kācajaṅghikā,

1.182.s:
gokarṇikāṃ gomukhikāṃ mahāgrīvāṃ mahāmukhīm..
ulkāmukhīṃ dhūmraśikhāṃ kavanāṃ parikaṃpitām .. 22 ..
1.182.d:
गोकर्णिकां गोमुखिकां महाग्रीवां महामुखीम्॥
उल्कामुखीं धूम्रशिखां कवनां परिकंपिताम् ॥ 22 ॥
1.182.m: Gokarṇikā, Gomukhikā, Mahāgrīvā, Mahāmukhī, / Ulkāmukhī, Dhūmraśikhā, Kavanā, Parikampitā,

1.182.s:
mohinīṃ kuṇḍinīṃ tveḍāṃ nirbhayāṃ bāhuśālinīm ..
śūrpakarṇīṃ tathaikākṣīṃ viśokāṃ nandinīṃ rucam .. 23 ..
1.182.d:
मोहिनीं कुण्डिनीं त्वेडां निर्भयां बाहुशालिनीम् ॥
शूर्पकर्णीं तथैकाक्षीं विशोकां नन्दिनीं रुचम् ॥ 23 ॥
1.182.m: Mohinī, Kuṇḍinī, Iḍā, Nirbhayā, Bāhuśālinī, / Śūrpakarṇī, Ekākṣī, Viśokā, Nandinī, Ruc,

1.182.s:
jyosrāmukhīṃ varaparāṃ nikumbhāṃ raktakampanām ..
avikārāṃ mahācitrāṃ citrasenāṃ manoramām .. 24 ..
1.182.d:
ज्योस्रामुखीं वरपरां निकुम्भां रक्तकम्पनाम् ॥
अविकारां महाचित्रां चित्रसेनां मनोरमाम् ॥ 24 ॥
1.182.m: Jyotsnāmukhī, Varaparā, Nikuṃbhā, Raktakampanā, / Avikārā, Mahācitrā, Citrasenā, Manoramā,

1.182.s:
sudarśanāṃ haratpāpāṃ mātaṅgīṃ laṃbamekhalām ..
subālāṃ bālatarkārīṃ premodāṃ lāṅgalāvatīm..25..
1.182.d:
सुदर्शनां हरत्पापां मातङ्गीं लंबमेखलाम् ॥
सुबालां बालतर्कारीं प्रेमोदां लाङ्गलावतीम्॥25॥
1.182.m: Sudarśanā, Haratpāpā, Mātaṅgī, Lambamekhalā, / Subālā, Bālatarkārī, Premodā, Lāṅgalāvatī,

1.182.s:
cittāṃ vittāṃ jaḍāṃ koṇāṃ śāntikāṃ bhasitāśanīm ..
laṃbastanīṃ laṃbaghaṇṭāṃ visatāṃ vāmacūḍinīm ..26..
1.182.d:
चित्तां वित्तां जडां कोणां शान्तिकां भसिताशनीम् ॥
लंबस्तनीं लंबघण्टां विसतां वामचूडिनीम् ॥26॥
1.182.m: Cittā, Vittā, Jaḍā, Koṇā, Śāntikā, Bhasitāśanī, / Lambastanī, Lambaghaṇṭā, Visatā, Vāmacūḍinī,

1.182.s:
svalatirdīrghakeśī ca sulatā sundarī samā ..
adhomukhī kaṭumukhī krodhanī vasuvāśinī .. 27 ..
1.182.d:
स्वलतिर्दीर्घकेशी च सुलता सुन्दरी समा ॥
अधोमुखी कटुमुखी क्रोधनी वसुवाशिनी ॥ 27 ॥
1.182.m: Svalati, Dīrghakeśī, Sulatā, Sundarī, Samā, / Adhomukhī, Kaṭumukhī, Krodhanī, Vasuvāśinī,

1.182.s:
virāviṇī vatsarutā māṣābhājinaśālinī ..
kuṭumbikā śuktikā ca caṇḍikā balamohinī .. 28 ..
1.182.d:
विराविणी वत्सरुता माषाभाजिनशालिनी ॥
कुटुम्बिका शुक्तिका च चण्डिका बलमोहिनी ॥ 28 ॥
1.182.m: Virāviṇī, Vatsarutā, Māṣābhājananśālinī, / Kuṭumbikā, Śuktikā, Caṇḍikā, Balamohinī,

1.182.s:
māṃsānyahāsinī lambā govidhārī samāgadhī ..
etāścānyāḥ sa devendra sasṛje mātarastadā .. 29 ..
1.182.d:
मांसान्यहासिनी लम्बा गोविधारी समागधी ॥
एताश्चान्याः स देवेन्द्र ससृजे मातरस्तदा ॥ 29 ॥
1.182.m: Māṃsānyahāsinī, Lambā, Govidhārī, Samāgadhī— / these and other Mothers the lord of gods created at that time.

1.182.s:
andhakānāṃ mahāghoraṃ papustadrudhiraṃ tadā ..
tatondhakāsṛjā sarvāḥ parāṃ tṛptimupāgatāḥ ..1.226.30..
1.182.d:
अन्धकानां महाघोरं पपुस्तद्रुधिरं तदा ॥
ततोन्धकासृजा सर्वाः परां तृप्तिमुपागताः ॥1.226.30॥
1.182.m: They then drank that most terrible blood of the Andhakas. / Then, by means of the blood of the Andhakas, they all attained supreme satisfaction.

1.182.s:
tāstu tṛptāḥ susambhūtā bhūya evāṃdhakāsrajā ..
arditoyairmahādevaḥ śūlamudgarapaṭṭiśaiḥ .. 31 ..
1.182.d:
तास्तु तृप्ताः सुसम्भूता भूय एवांधकास्रजा ॥
अर्दितोयैर्महादेवः शूलमुद्गरपट्टिशैः ॥ 31 ॥
1.182.m: Yet from that blood of the Andhakas, they [more Andhakas] arose again in great numbers, even though [the Mothers were] satisfied; / and by them Mahādeva was afflicted with tridents, clubs, and spears.

1.182.s:
tataḥ sa śaṅkaro devastvandhakairvyākulīkṛtaḥ ..
jagāma śaraṇaṃ devaṃ vāsudevamajaṃ vibhum .. 32 ..
1.182.d:
ततः स शङ्करो देवस्त्वन्धकैर्व्याकुलीकृतः ॥
जगाम शरणं देवं वासुदेवमजं विभुम् ॥ 32 ॥
1.182.m: Then the god Śaṅkara, distressed by the Andhakas, / went for refuge to the god Vāsudeva, the unborn and all-pervading lord.

1.182.s:
tatastu bhagavānviṣṇuḥ sṛṣṭavāñchuṣkarevatīm ..
sā papau satvaraṃ teṣāmandhakānāmasṛkkṣaṇāt .. 33 ..
1.182.d:
ततस्तु भगवान्विष्णुः सृष्टवाञ्छुष्करेवतीम् ॥
सा पपौ सत्वरं तेषामन्धकानामसृक्क्षणात् ॥ 33 ॥
1.182.m: Thereupon the blessed Lord Viṣṇu created Śuṣkarevatī. / In an instant, she quickly drank the blood of those Andhakas.

1.182.s:
yathāyathā ca rudhiraṃ pibatyandhakasambhavam ..
tathā tathā'dhikaṃ devī saṃśuṣyati janādhipa .. 34 ..
1.182.d:
यथायथा च रुधिरं पिबत्यन्धकसम्भवम् ॥
तथा तथाऽधिकं देवी संशुष्यति जनाधिप ॥ 34 ॥
1.182.m: And the more she drank the blood arising from the Andhakas, / all the more, O ruler of men, the goddess dried up.

1.182.s:
pīyamāne tadā teṣāmandhakānāṃ tathāsṛji ..
andhakāstu kṣayaṃ nītā sarve te tripurāriṇā .. 35 ..
1.182.d:
पीयमाने तदा तेषामन्धकानां तथासृजि ॥
अन्धकास्तु क्षयं नीता सर्वे ते त्रिपुरारिणा ॥ 35 ॥
1.182.m: As the blood of those Andhakas was being drunk, / all those Andhakas were brought to destruction by the enemy of Tripura.

1.182.s:
mūlāndhakaṃ tu vikramya tadā sarvatra lokakṛt ..
cakāra vegāñchūlāgre tadā tuṣṭāva śaṅkaram .. 36 ..
1.182.d:
मूलान्धकं तु विक्रम्य तदा सर्वत्र लोककृत् ॥
चकार वेगाञ्छूलाग्रे तदा तुष्टाव शङ्करम् ॥ 36 ॥
1.182.m: Then, striding over the original Andhaka everywhere, the creator of the world / swiftly impaled him on the tip of his trident; and he [Andhaka] then praised Śaṅkara.

1.182.s:
andhakaḥ sumahāvīryaḥ tasya tuṣṭo'bhavadbhavaḥ ..
sāmīpyaṃ pradadau nityaṃ gaṇeśatvaṃ tathaiva ca .. 37 ..
1.182.d:
अन्धकः सुमहावीर्यः तस्य तुष्टोऽभवद्भवः ॥
सामीप्यं प्रददौ नित्यं गणेशत्वं तथैव च ॥ 37 ॥
1.182.m: Andhaka possessed exceedingly great valor. Bhava was pleased with him; / he granted him eternal proximity and likewise the leadership of the gaṇas.

1.182.s:
tato mātṛgaṇāḥ sarve śaṅkaraṃ vākyamabruvan ..
bhagavan bhakṣayiṣyāmaḥ sadevāsuramānuṣam .. 38 ..
1.182.d:
ततो मातृगणाः सर्वे शङ्करं वाक्यमब्रुवन् ॥
भगवन् भक्षयिष्यामः सदेवासुरमानुषम् ॥ 38 ॥
1.182.m: Then all the troops of Mothers said to Śaṅkara: / "O Blessed Lord, we wish to consume the gods, asuras, and human beings.

1.182.s:
tvatprasādājjagatsarvaṃ tadanujñātumarhasi ..
śaṅkara uvāca ..
bhavatībhiḥ prajāḥ sarvā rakṣaṇīyā na saṃśayaḥ .. 39 ..
1.182.d:
त्वत्प्रसादाज्जगत्सर्वं तदनुज्ञातुमर्हसि ॥
शङ्कर उवाच ॥
भवतीभिः प्रजाः सर्वा रक्षणीया न संशयः ॥ 39 ॥
1.182.m: By your favor, you should allow [us to consume] the entire universe." / Śaṅkara said: / "All creatures must be protected by you, without doubt.

1.182.s:
tasmādghorādabhiprāyānmanaḥ śīghraṃ nivartyatām ..
nāḍāyana uvāca ..
ityevaṃ śaṅkareṇoktaṃ tvanādṛtya vacastu tāḥ .. 1.226.40 ..
1.182.d:
तस्माद्घोरादभिप्रायान्मनः शीघ्रं निवर्त्यताम् ॥
नाडायन उवाच ॥
इत्येवं शङ्करेणोक्तं त्वनादृत्य वचस्तु ताः ॥ 1.226.40 ॥
1.182.m: Therefore let your minds be quickly turned away from that terrible intention." / Nāḍāyana said: / But disregarding the words spoken thus by Śaṅkara, they, 1.226.40

1.182.s:
kṣobhayāmāsu'vyagrāstrailokyaṃ sacarācaram . .
trailokye bhakṣyamāṇe tu tadā mātṛgaṇairnavaiḥ .. 41 ..
1.182.d:
क्षोभयामासुऽव्यग्रास्त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् ॥
त्रैलोक्ये भक्ष्यमाणे तु तदा मातृगणैर्नवैः ॥ 41 ॥
1.182.m: undismayed, agitated the three worlds, both moving and unmoving. / While the three worlds were being devoured by the newly-arisen troops of Mothers, 41

1.182.s:
nṛsiṃhamūrtiṃ devaṃ ca pradadhyau bhagavāñchivaḥ ..
anādinidhanaṃ devaṃ sarvalokabhavodbhavama .. 42 ..
1.182.d:
नृसिंहमूर्तिं देवं च प्रदध्यौ भगवाञ्छिवः ॥
अनादिनिधनं देवं सर्वलोकभवोद्भवम ॥ 42 ॥
1.182.m: the blessed Lord Śiva meditated upon the god in his Nṛsiṃha form, / the god without beginning or end, the source of the existence of all worlds, 42

1.182.s:
daityendravakṣorudhiraprokṣitorumahānakhama ..
vidyujjihvaṃ mahādaṃṣṭraṃ sphuṭakesarasaṅkaṭam .. 43 ..
1.182.d:
दैत्येन्द्रवक्षोरुधिरप्रोक्षितोरुमहानखम ॥
विद्युज्जिह्वं महादंष्ट्रं स्फुटकेसरसङ्कटम् ॥ 43 ॥
1.182.m: whose great claws were sprinkled with the blood of the demon king's chest, / with a tongue like lightning, huge fangs, and thick with bristling manes, 43

1.182.s:
kalpāntamārutakṣubdhasaptārṇava mahāsvanama ..
vajrāgratīkṣṇanakharamākarṇāddāritānanam.. 44 ..
1.182.d:
कल्पान्तमारुतक्षुब्धसप्तार्णव महास्वनम ॥
वज्राग्रतीक्ष्णनखरमाकर्णाद्दारिताननम्॥ 44 ॥
1.182.m: making a mighty roar like the seven oceans stirred by the wind at the end of the aeon, / whose claws were as sharp as the point of a vajra, his mouth torn open to the ears, 44

1.182.s:
maruśailapratīkāśamudayārkasamekṣaṇama ..
himādriśikharākāraṃ cārudaṃṣṭrojjvalānanam .. 45 ..
1.182.d:
मरुशैलप्रतीकाशमुदयार्कसमेक्षणम ॥
हिमाद्रिशिखराकारं चारुदंष्ट्रोज्ज्वलाननम् ॥ 45 ॥
1.182.m: resembling the desert mountain, his gaze like the rising sun, / having the appearance of a peak of the Himalaya, his radiant face lovely with fangs, 45

1.182.s:
khavinissṛtaromāgniṃ jvālākesaramālinam ..
baddhāṅgadaṃ sumukuṭaṃ cārukeyūrabhūṣaṇama .. 46 ..
1.182.d:
खविनिस्सृतरोमाग्निं ज्वालाकेसरमालिनम् ॥
बद्धाङ्गदं सुमुकुटं चारुकेयूरभूषणम ॥ 46 ॥
1.182.m: with fires of bodily hair issuing into the sky, garlanded with manes of flames, / wearing armlets, an excellent crown, and adorned with beautiful bracelets, 46

1.182.s:
śroṇīsūtreṇa mahatā kāñcanena virājitama ..
nīlotpaladalaśyāmaṃ vāmoyugavibhūṣitama .. 47 ..
1.182.d:
श्रोणीसूत्रेण महता काञ्चनेन विराजितम ॥
नीलोत्पलदलश्यामं वामोयुगविभूषितम ॥ 47 ॥
1.182.m: resplendent with a large golden girdle, / dark like the petal of a blue lotus, adorned with a pair of garments, 47

1.182.s:
tejasākrāntasakalaṃ brahmāṇḍāntaramaṃḍapama ..
sādarabhrāmyamāṇānāṃ hutahavya ghanārciṣām .. 48 ..
1.182.d:
तेजसाक्रान्तसकलं ब्रह्माण्डान्तरमंडपम ॥
सादरभ्राम्यमाणानां हुतहव्य घनार्चिषाम् ॥ 48 ॥
1.182.m: pervading the entire pavilion within the cosmic egg with his splendour, / with body-hairs resembling spirals / of thick flames of offered oblations being reverently whirled about, 48

1.182.s:
āvarttaiḥ sadṛśākāraiḥ saṃyuktaṃ daihalomajaiḥ ..
sarvapuppavicitrāṃ ca dhārayānaṃ mahāsrajama .. 49 ..
1.182.d:
आवर्त्तैः सदृशाकारैः संयुक्तं दैहलोमजैः ॥
सर्वपुप्पविचित्रां च धारयानं महास्रजम ॥ 49 ॥
1.182.m: and wearing a great garland variegated with all kinds of flowers. 49

1.182.s:
sa dhyātamātro bhagavānpradadau tasya darśanam ..
yādṛśenaiva rūpeṇa yāto rudreṇa bhaktitaḥ .. 1.226.50 ..
1.182.d:
स ध्यातमात्रो भगवान्प्रददौ तस्य दर्शनम् ॥
यादृशेनैव रूपेण यातो रुद्रेण भक्तितः ॥ 1.226.50 ॥
1.182.m: As soon as he was meditated upon, the Blessed Lord granted him a vision, / in that very form in which Rudra, through devotion, had approached [him], 1.226.50

1.182.s:
tādṛśenaiva rūpeṇa durnirīkṣyeṇa daivataiḥ ..
praṇipatya tu deveśaṃ tadā tuṣṭāva śaṅkaraḥ .. 51 ..
1.182.d:
तादृशेनैव रूपेण दुर्निरीक्ष्येण दैवतैः ॥
प्रणिपत्य तु देवेशं तदा तुष्टाव शङ्करः ॥ 51 ॥
1.182.m: in that very form which was hard to behold even by the gods. / Having bowed down to the lord of gods, Śaṅkara then praised [him]: 51

1.182.s:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
namastestu jagannātha narasiṃhavapurdharaḥ ..
daityanāthāsthisaṃpūrṇa nakhaśuktivirājita .. 52 ..
1.182.d:
शङ्कर उवाच ॥
नमस्तेस्तु जगन्नाथ नरसिंहवपुर्धरः ॥
दैत्यनाथास्थिसंपूर्ण नखशुक्तिविराजित ॥ 52 ॥
1.182.m: Śaṅkara said: / "Obeisance to you, Lord of the universe, bearer of the Narasiṃha body, / resplendent with claws like oyster shells filled with the bones of the demon king, 52

1.182.s:
tadasrakaṇasaṃlagnahemapiṅgalavigrahaṃ ..
meroḥ sapadmarāgasya śobhāṃ dhatse jagadguro .. 53 ..
1.182.d:
तदस्रकणसंलग्नहेमपिङ्गलविग्रहं ॥
मेरोः सपद्मरागस्य शोभां धत्से जगद्गुरो ॥ 53 ॥
1.182.m: your reddish-gold body touched with droplets of his blood! / O teacher of the universe, you bear the beauty of Mount Meru adorned with rubies, 53

1.182.s:
kalpāntāmbhodanirghoṣa sūryakoṭisamaprabha ..
sahasrayama saṃkrodha sahasrendraparākrama .. 54 ..
1.182.d:
कल्पान्ताम्भोदनिर्घोष सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभ ॥
सहस्रयम संक्रोध सहस्रेन्द्रपराक्रम ॥ 54 ॥
1.182.m: thundering like clouds at the end of the aeon, equal in splendour to ten million suns, / having the fury of a thousand Yamas, the prowess of a thousand Indras, 54

1.182.s:
sahasradhanadasphīta sahasravaruṇātmaka..
sahasrakālacarita sahasraniyatendriya..55..
1.182.d:
सहस्रधनदस्फीत सहस्रवरुणात्मक॥
सहस्रकालचरित सहस्रनियतेन्द्रिय॥55॥
1.182.m: abundant like a thousand Dhanadas, having the nature of a thousand Varuṇas, / acting like a thousand Kālās, having the self-control of a thousand restrained [sages], 55

1.182.s:
sahasrabhūmisaddhairya sahasrānantamūrttimat ..
sahasracandrapratima sahasraharivikrama .. 56 ..
1.182.d:
सहस्रभूमिसद्धैर्य सहस्रानन्तमूर्त्तिमत् ॥
सहस्रचन्द्रप्रतिम सहस्रहरिविक्रम ॥ 56 ॥
1.182.m: having the true steadfastness of a thousand earths, having the forms of a thousand Anantas, / resembling a thousand moons, having the strides of a thousand Haris, 56

1.182.s:
sahasrarudratejaska sahasrabrahmasaṃstuta..
sahasravāyuvegogra sahasrajyotirīṣaṇa..57..
1.182.d:
सहस्ररुद्रतेजस्क सहस्रब्रह्मसंस्तुत॥
सहस्रवायुवेगोग्र सहस्रज्योतिरीषण॥57॥
1.182.m: possessing the splendour of a thousand Rudras, praised by a thousand Brahmās, / fierce with the speed of a thousand winds, with the gaze of a thousand lights, 57

1.182.s:
sahasrayantramathana sahasrābādhamocana ..
andhakasya vināśāya sṛṣṭā yā mātaro mayā .. 58 ..
1.182.d:
सहस्रयन्त्रमथन सहस्राबाधमोचन ॥
अन्धकस्य विनाशाय सृष्टा या मातरो मया ॥ 58 ॥
1.182.m: crusher of a thousand snares, deliverer from a thousand afflictions! / The Mothers who were created by me for the destruction of Andhaka, 58

1.182.s:
anādṛtya tu madvākyaṃ bhakṣayaṃtyaśca tāḥ prajāḥ ..
kṛtvā tāśca na śakto'haṃ saṃhantumaparājita..59..
1.182.d:
अनादृत्य तु मद्वाक्यं भक्षयंत्यश्च ताः प्रजाः ॥
कृत्वा ताश्च न शक्तोऽहं संहन्तुमपराजित॥59॥
1.182.m: disregarding my command, are devouring the creatures. / Having created them, I am unable to destroy them, O unconquered one! 59

1.182.s:
svayaṃ kṛtvā kathaṃ tāsāṃ vināśamapi rocaye ..
nāḍāyana uvāca ..
evamuktaḥ sa rudreṇa nārasiṃha vapurdharaḥ .. 1.226.60 ..
1.182.d:
स्वयं कृत्वा कथं तासां विनाशमपि रोचये ॥
नाडायन उवाच ॥
एवमुक्तः स रुद्रेण नारसिंह वपुर्धरः ॥ 1.226.60 ॥
1.182.m: Having created [them] myself, how could I even wish for their destruction?" / Nāḍāyana said: / Being addressed in this way by Rudra, he who bore the Nārasiṃha body 1.226.60

1.182.s:
sasarja devīṃ jihvātaḥ tadā vāgīśvarīṃ hariḥ ..
hṛdayācca tathā māyāṃ guhyācca bhagamālinīm .. 61 ..
1.182.d:
ससर्ज देवीं जिह्वातः तदा वागीश्वरीं हरिः ॥
हृदयाच्च तथा मायां गुह्याच्च भगमालिनीम् ॥ 61 ॥
1.182.m: then created from his tongue the goddess Vāgīśvarī, Hari [created] Māyā / from his heart, and from his secret part Bhagamālinī. 61

1.182.s:
asthibhyaśca tathā kālī sṛṣṭā pūrvaṃ mahātmanā ..
yayā tadrudhiraṃ pītamandhakānāṃ mahātmanām .. 62 ..
1.182.d:
अस्थिभ्यश्च तथा काली सृष्टा पूर्वं महात्मना ॥
यया तद्रुधिरं पीतमन्धकानां महात्मनाम् ॥ 62 ॥
1.182.m: And Kālī had been created earlier from his bones by the Great Soul, / by whom that blood of the mighty Andhakas was drunk, 62

1.182.s:
yā tvasminkathitā loke nāmataḥ śuṣkarevatī ..
dvātriṃśanmātaraḥ sṛṣṭā gātrebhyaścakriṇā tataḥ .. 63 ..
1.182.d:
या त्वस्मिन्कथिता लोके नामतः शुष्करेवती ॥
द्वात्रिंशन्मातरः सृष्टा गात्रेभ्यश्चक्रिणा ततः ॥ 63 ॥
1.182.m: she who is spoken of by name in this world as Śuṣkarevatī. / Then thirty-two Mothers were created from his limbs by the Bearer of the Discus. 63

1.182.s:
tāsāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi tāni me gadataḥ śṛṇu ..
sarvakliṣṭā mahābhāgā kaṇṭhakarṇī tathaiva ca .. 64..
1.182.d:
तासां नामानि वक्ष्यामि तानि मे गदतः शृणु ॥
सर्वक्लिष्टा महाभागा कण्ठकर्णी तथैव च ॥ 64॥
1.182.m: I shall state their names; hear them from me as I speak: / the illustrious Sarvakliṣṭā, and likewise Kaṇṭhakarṇī, 64

1.182.s:
trailokya mohinī puṇyā sarvasattvavaśaṅkarī ..
tathā ca cakrahṛdayā pañcamā vyomacāriṇī ..65..
1.182.d:
त्रैलोक्य मोहिनी पुण्या सर्वसत्त्ववशङ्करी ॥
तथा च चक्रहृदया पञ्चमा व्योमचारिणी ॥65॥
1.182.m: Trailokyamohinī, holy, Sarvasattvavaśaṅkarī, / and Cakrahṛdayā, the fifth Vyomacāriṇī, 65

1.182.s:
śaṃkhinī lekhinī caiva kālasaṅkarṣiṇī tathā ..
iti devyaṣṭakaṃ rājanvāgīśyanucaraṃ smṛtam .. 66 ..
1.182.d:
शंखिनी लेखिनी चैव कालसङ्कर्षिणी तथा ॥
इति देव्यष्टकं राजन्वागीश्यनुचरं स्मृतम् ॥ 66 ॥
1.182.m: Śaṅkhinī, Lekhinī, and likewise Kālasaṅkarṣiṇī: / this group of eight goddesses, O king, is considered the retinue of Vāgīśī. 66

1.182.s:
ajitā sūkṣmahṛdayā vṛkṣāveśāśmadarśanā ..
nṛsiṃhabhairavā cillā garutpakṣahṛdānayā .. 67 ..
1.182.d:
अजिता सूक्ष्महृदया वृक्षावेशाश्मदर्शना ॥
नृसिंहभैरवा चिल्ला गरुत्पक्षहृदानया ॥ 67 ॥
1.182.m: Ajitā, Sūkṣmahṛdayā, Vṛkṣāveśā, Aśmadarśanā, / Nṛsiṃhabhairavā, Cillā, Garutpakṣahṛdānayā: 67

1.182.s:
bhagamālinya 'nucarā ityaṣṭau nṛpa mātaraḥ ..
ākarṣiṇī ca bhārūṭī tathaivottaramālikā .. 68 ..
1.182.d:
भगमालिन्य ऽनुचरा इत्यष्टौ नृप मातरः ॥
आकर्षिणी च भारूटी तथैवोत्तरमालिका ॥ 68 ॥
1.182.m: these eight Mothers, O king, are the attendants of Bhagamālinī. / Ākarṣiṇī, Bhārūṭī, and likewise Uttaramālikā, 68

1.182.s:
jvālāmukhī bhīṣaṇikā kāmadhenuśca bālikā ..
tathā padmakarā rājanrevatyanucarāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 69 ..
1.182.d:
ज्वालामुखी भीषणिका कामधेनुश्च बालिका ॥
तथा पद्मकरा राजन्रेवत्यनुचराः स्मृताः ॥ 69 ॥
1.182.m: Jvālāmukhī, Bhīṣaṇikā, Kāmadhenu, and Bālikā, / and Padmakarā, O king, are considered the attendants of Revatī. 69

1.182.s:
aṣṭau mahābalāḥ sarvā devagātrasamudbhavāḥ ..
trailokyasṛṣṭisaṃhārasamarthāḥ sarvadevatāḥ .. 1.226.70 ..
1.182.d:
अष्टौ महाबलाः सर्वा देवगात्रसमुद्भवाः ॥
त्रैलोक्यसृष्टिसंहारसमर्थाः सर्वदेवताः ॥ 1.226.70 ॥
1.182.m: All eight are possessed of great power, born from the body of the god, / capable of creating and destroying the three worlds, all goddesses. 1.226.70

1.182.s:
tāḥ sṛṣṭamātrā devena kruddhā mātṛgaṇasya tu ..
pradhāvitā mahārāja krodhavisphūrjitekṣaṇāḥ .. 71 ..
1.182.d:
ताः सृष्टमात्रा देवेन क्रुद्धा मातृगणस्य तु ॥
प्रधाविता महाराज क्रोधविस्फूर्जितेक्षणाः ॥ 71 ॥
1.182.m: As soon as they were created by the god, angered at the troop of Mothers, / they rushed forward, O great king, their eyes blazing with wrath. 71

1.182.s:
aviṣahyatamaṃ tāsāṃ dṛṣṭvā tejaḥ sudāruṇam ..
bhayena śaraṇaṃ prāptā deveśaṃ pūrvamātaraḥ .. 72 ..
1.182.d:
अविषह्यतमं तासां दृष्ट्वा तेजः सुदारुणम् ॥
भयेन शरणं प्राप्ता देवेशं पूर्वमातरः ॥ 72 ॥
1.182.m: Seeing their most unbearable and dreadful splendour, / the former Mothers went to the lord of gods for refuge out of fear. 72

1.182.s:
śaraṇārthamanuprāptā nṛsiṃho vākyamabravīt ..
narasiṃha uvāca ..
yathā manuṣyāḥ paśavaḥ pālayanti varānanāḥ .. 73 ..
1.182.d:
शरणार्थमनुप्राप्ता नृसिंहो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥
नरसिंह उवाच ॥
यथा मनुष्याः पशवः पालयन्ति वराननाः ॥ 73 ॥
1.182.m: To those who had arrived seeking refuge, Nṛsiṃha spoke these words: / Narasiṃha said: / "Just as men protect cattle, O fair-faced ones, 73

1.182.s:
yajanti taiśca paśubhiḥ tathā vai devatāgaṇān ..
bhavatyaśca tathā lokānpālayantu mayeritāḥ ..74 ..
1.182.d:
यजन्ति तैश्च पशुभिः तथा वै देवतागणान् ॥
भवत्यश्च तथा लोकान्पालयन्तु मयेरिताः ॥74 ॥
1.182.m: and with those cattle sacrifice to the hosts of gods, / so also, directed by me, protect the worlds. 74

1.182.s:
manujaiśca tathā devaṃ yajadhvaṃ tripurāntakam..
ye ca māṃ saṃsmaraṃtīha te ca rakṣyā sadā narāḥ ..75..
1.182.d:
मनुजैश्च तथा देवं यजध्वं त्रिपुरान्तकम्॥
ये च मां संस्मरंतीह ते च रक्ष्या सदा नराः ॥75॥
1.182.m: And together with men worship the god who brought an end to Tripura; / and those men who remember me here are always to be protected. 75

1.182.s:
balikarma kariṣyaṃti yuṣmākaṃ ye sadā narāḥ ..
sarvakāmapradāsteṣāṃ bhaviṣyadhvaṃ tathaiva ca..76..
1.182.d:
बलिकर्म करिष्यंति युष्माकं ये सदा नराः ॥
सर्वकामप्रदास्तेषां भविष्यध्वं तथैव च॥76॥
1.182.m: Those men who will always make offerings of food to you /—to them you shall also grant all desires. 76

1.182.s:
tatsādanādikaṃ ye ca kariṣyaṃti hareritam ..
te ca rakṣyā sadā loke rakṣitavyaṃ ca śāsanam..77..
1.182.d:
तत्सादनादिकं ये च करिष्यंति हरेरितम् ॥
ते च रक्ष्या सदा लोके रक्षितव्यं च शासनम्॥77॥
1.182.m: And those who build their temples and the like, as spoken by Hari, / they are always to be protected in the world, and my ordinance must be observed. 77

1.182.s:
raudrāṃ caiva parāṃ mūrtiṃ mahādevaḥ pradāsyati..
yuṣmabhyaṃ samayā sārdhaṃ tena sārdhaṃ varasyatha ..78..
1.182.d:
रौद्रां चैव परां मूर्तिं महादेवः प्रदास्यति॥
युष्मभ्यं समया सार्धं तेन सार्धं वरस्यथ ॥78॥
1.182.m: And Mahādeva will grant you a supreme, dreadful form; / together with that covenant you shall dwell with him. 78

1.182.s:
mayā mātṛgaṇaḥ sṛṣṭo yoyaṃ vigatasādhvasaḥ ..
eṣa nityaṃ viśālākṣyo mayaiva saha raṃsyati ..79..
1.182.d:
मया मातृगणः सृष्टो योयं विगतसाध्वसः ॥
एष नित्यं विशालाक्ष्यो मयैव सह रंस्यति ॥79॥
1.182.m: This troop of Mothers which has been created by me, free from fear, / this [host] of large-eyed ones will delight forever with me alone. 79

1.182.s:
mayā sārdhaṃ tathā pūjāṃ vīrebhyaścaiva lapsyasi ..
pṛthak ca pūjito loke sarvānkāmānpradāsyati .. 1.226.80 ..
1.182.d:
मया सार्धं तथा पूजां वीरेभ्यश्चैव लप्स्यसि ॥
पृथक् च पूजितो लोके सर्वान्कामान्प्रदास्यति ॥ 1.226.80 ॥
1.182.m: Along with me, you will receive worship from heroes; / and worshipped separately in the world, [this host] will grant all desires." 1.226.80

1.182.s:
śuṣkāṃ saṃpūjayiṣyanti ye tu putrārthino janāḥ..
teṣāṃ putrapradā devī bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ..81..
1.182.d:
शुष्कां संपूजयिष्यन्ति ये तु पुत्रार्थिनो जनाः॥
तेषां पुत्रप्रदा देवी भविष्यति न संशयः॥81॥
1.182.m:
Those people desirous of sons who worship Śuṣkā,
to them that goddess will grant sons, there is no doubt.

1.182.s:
nāḍāyana uvāca..
etāvaduktvā bhagavānsaha mātṛgaṇena ca ..
jvālāmālākulavapustatraivāṃtaradhīyata ..82..
1.182.d:
नाडायन उवाच॥
एतावदुक्त्वा भगवान्सह मातृगणेन च ॥
ज्वालामालाकुलवपुस्तत्रैवांतरधीयत ॥82॥
1.182.m:
Nāḍāyana said:
Having spoken thus, the Lord, along with the troop of Mothers,
his body surrounded by garlands of flames, vanished right there.

1.182.s:
samātṛvargopi harasya mūrti sadā yajaṃstiṣṭhati tatsamīpe ..
deveśvarasyāpi nṛsiṃhamūrteḥ pūjāṃ vidhatte tripurāntakārī .. 83 ..
1.227
.. śailūṣa uvāca ..
mātṛdoṣapraśamanānmaheśvaramukhodgatān ..
prayogāñchrotumicchāmi vadataste dvijottama .. 1 ..
nāḍāyana uvāca ..
cocakaṃ tu vacā kuṣṭaṃ brahmabhūtajaṭe śubhe ..
kālamañjā haridre dve yavacūrṇavimiśritam..2..
udvartanamidaṃ proktaṃ mātṛdoṣavināśanam ..
ariṣṭāriṣṭapatrāṇi tālajītakayostathā .. 3 ..
śiṃśipāmalakībilvakapitthānāṃ tathaiva ca ..
bahukāratvacaṃ pūrvāṃ tathaiva ca punarnavām .. 4 ..
bhārṅgīkvāthamidaṃ snānaṃ mātṛdoṣavināśanam ..
ariṣṭakaṃ tathā bilvaṃ padmākṣaṃ phalinīphalam .. 5 ..
vacā kuṣṭaṃ ca mustañca vālakaṃ rajanīdvayam ..
candanaṃ kuṃkumaṃ caiva nāgadānaṃ ca rocanā .. 6 ..
1.182.d:
समातृवर्गोपि हरस्य मूर्ति सदा यजंस्तिष्ठति तत्समीपे ॥
देवेश्वरस्यापि नृसिंहमूर्तेः पूजां विधत्ते त्रिपुरान्तकारी ॥ 83 ॥
1.227
॥ शैलूष उवाच ॥
मातृदोषप्रशमनान्महेश्वरमुखोद्गतान् ॥
प्रयोगाञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि वदतस्ते द्विजोत्तम ॥ 1 ॥
नाडायन उवाच ॥
चोचकं तु वचा कुष्टं ब्रह्मभूतजटे शुभे ॥
कालमञ्जा हरिद्रे द्वे यवचूर्णविमिश्रितम्॥2॥
उद्वर्तनमिदं प्रोक्तं मातृदोषविनाशनम् ॥
अरिष्टारिष्टपत्राणि तालजीतकयोस्तथा ॥ 3 ॥
शिंशिपामलकीबिल्वकपित्थानां तथैव च ॥
बहुकारत्वचं पूर्वां तथैव च पुनर्नवाम् ॥ 4 ॥
भार्ङ्गीक्वाथमिदं स्नानं मातृदोषविनाशनम् ॥
अरिष्टकं तथा बिल्वं पद्माक्षं फलिनीफलम् ॥ 5 ॥
वचा कुष्टं च मुस्तञ्च वालकं रजनीद्वयम् ॥
चन्दनं कुंकुमं चैव नागदानं च रोचना ॥ 6 ॥
1.182.m:
Together with the group of Mothers, he remains near Hara, constantly worshipping his form; / and the Destroyer of Tripura performs worship to the lord of gods, who has the form of Nṛsiṃha.
1.227
Śailūṣa said:
I wish to hear from you speaking, O best of the twice-born,
the rites issued from the mouth of Maheśvara that appease the afflictions caused by the Mothers.
Nāḍāyana said:
Cocaka, vacā, kuṣṭha, auspicious brahmabhūtajaṭā,
kālamañjā, and the two haridrās, mixed with barley powder:
this is declared as an unguent for rubbing, destroying the afflictions caused by the Mothers.
Leaves of the two kinds of ariṣṭa, as well as of the tālajītaka,
and likewise of the śiṃśipā, āmalakī, bilva, and kapittha;
the bark of the bahukāra taken beforehand, and also punarnavā,
and a decoction of bhārṅgī—this bath destroys the afflictions caused by the Mothers.
Ariṣṭaka, bilva, lotus-seeds, phalinī fruit,
vacā, kuṣṭha, mustā, vālaka, the two rajanīs,
sandalwood, saffron, nāgadāna, and rocanā:

1.182.s:
etāni sarvāṇyāhṛtya pūrṇakumbhe vinikṣipet ..
snānametatprayoktavyaṃ mātṛdoṣavināśanam .. 7 ..
kusumaiḥ pañcavarṇaistu dhūpairniryāsajaistathā ..
kuṃkumāgurukarpūracandanaiśca manoramaiḥ .. 8 ..
dīpairbhakṣyaistathā kṣīraiḥ kulmāṣollopikāguḍaiḥ ..
pāyasairmadhusaṃmiśraiḥ palalenodanena ca .. ..9..
baliḥ suvihito rājanmātṛdoṣavināśanam ..
dūrvāpravālamañjiṣṭhānāgaraṃ nāgakeśaram..1.227.10..
rocanākuṃkumaṃ caiva candanaṃ ca tathā vacā ..
vilepanamidaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mātṛdoṣavināśanam .. 11 ..
gajāśvakapivārāhanakhāni ca ghṛtaṃ tathā ..
śreṣṭho'yaṃ kathito dhūpo mātṛdoṣavināśanaḥ .. 12 ..
siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ cāpyatha pañcagavyaṃ purāṇamaśnanti hi ye narendra ..
teṣāṃ bhayaṃ naiva hi mātṛjātaṃ bhāvyaṃ kadācidgrahasaṃbhavaṃ vā .. 13 ..
1.182.d:
एतानि सर्वाण्याहृत्य पूर्णकुम्भे विनिक्षिपेत् ॥
स्नानमेतत्प्रयोक्तव्यं मातृदोषविनाशनम् ॥ 7 ॥
कुसुमैः पञ्चवर्णैस्तु धूपैर्निर्यासजैस्तथा ॥
कुंकुमागुरुकर्पूरचन्दनैश्च मनोरमैः ॥ 8 ॥
दीपैर्भक्ष्यैस्तथा क्षीरैः कुल्माषोल्लोपिकागुडैः ॥
पायसैर्मधुसंमिश्रैः पललेनोदनेन च ॥ ॥9॥
बलिः सुविहितो राजन्मातृदोषविनाशनम् ॥
दूर्वाप्रवालमञ्जिष्ठानागरं नागकेशरम्॥1.227.10॥
रोचनाकुंकुमं चैव चन्दनं च तथा वचा ॥
विलेपनमिदं श्रेष्ठं मातृदोषविनाशनम् ॥ 11 ॥
गजाश्वकपिवाराहनखानि च घृतं तथा ॥
श्रेष्ठोऽयं कथितो धूपो मातृदोषविनाशनः ॥ 12 ॥
सिद्धं घृतं चाप्यथ पञ्चगव्यं पुराणमश्नन्ति हि ये नरेन्द्र ॥
तेषां भयं नैव हि मातृजातं भाव्यं कदाचिद्ग्रहसंभवं वा ॥ 13 ॥
1.182.m:
having gathered all these, one should throw them into a full jar.
This bath is to be employed to destroy the afflictions caused by the Mothers.
With flowers of five colours, and incense made from resins,
with delightful saffron, agallochum, camphor, and sandalwood,
with lamps, edible delicacies, milk, sour gruel, ollopikās, and jaggery,
with pāyasa mixed with honey, with meat, and with cooked rice,
an offering duly performed destroys the afflictions caused by the Mothers, O king.
Sprouts of dūrvā grass, mañjiṣṭhā, ginger, nāgakeśara,
rocanā, saffron, sandalwood, and likewise vacā:
this is the supreme ointment that destroys the afflictions caused by the Mothers.
Claws of an elephant, horse, monkey, and boar, and also ghee:
this is declared the supreme incense that destroys the afflictions caused by the Mothers.
Those who consume consecrated ghee and aged pañcagavya, O king, / will never suffer any fear born of the Mothers, nor one arising from planetary seizures.

1.182.s:
1.228
.. nāḍāyana uvāca ..
tasya devādidevasya prabhāvamaparaṃ śṛṇu ..
kathyamānaṃ mayā rājansarvakalmaṣanāśanam .. 1 ..
śaṅkaraḥ pārvatī caiva spardhamānau parasparam ..
cakraturmaithunaṃ rājansāgraṃ varṣaśataṃ kila.. 2 ..
tayoranyatarasyāsīdyadā naiva parājayaḥ ..
tatastu devatā khinnāḥ parasparamathābruvan .. 3 ..
atrotpatsyati yo garbhastrailokyaṃ sacarācaram ..
tejasā mohitaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ .. 4 ..
tasmāttvamatra praviśa devadeva hutāśana ..
evamuktastadā vahniḥ praviveśa surottamam.. 5 ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃbhramādeva samuttasthau trilocanaḥ ..
tejobhiḥ kṣubhitaṃ tatra vahnerāsyamathāviśat ..6..

1.182.d:
1.228
॥ नाडायन उवाच ॥
तस्य देवादिदेवस्य प्रभावमपरं शृणु ॥
कथ्यमानं मया राजन्सर्वकल्मषनाशनम् ॥ 1 ॥
शङ्करः पार्वती चैव स्पर्धमानौ परस्परम् ॥
चक्रतुर्मैथुनं राजन्साग्रं वर्षशतं किल॥ 2 ॥
तयोरन्यतरस्यासीद्यदा नैव पराजयः ॥
ततस्तु देवता खिन्नाः परस्परमथाब्रुवन् ॥ 3 ॥
अत्रोत्पत्स्यति यो गर्भस्त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् ॥
तेजसा मोहितं तस्य भविष्यति न संशयः ॥ 4 ॥
तस्मात्त्वमत्र प्रविश देवदेव हुताशन ॥
एवमुक्तस्तदा वह्निः प्रविवेश सुरोत्तमम्॥ 5 ॥
तं दृष्ट्वा संभ्रमादेव समुत्तस्थौ त्रिलोचनः ॥
तेजोभिः क्षुभितं तत्र वह्नेरास्यमथाविशत् ॥6॥
शशाप पार्वती देवी भार्यासु स्वासु देवताः ॥
नैवावाप्स्यथ पुत्रान्वै मत्कोधकलुषीकृताः ॥ 7 ॥
1.182.m:
1.228
Nāḍāyana said:
Hear further power of that God of gods,
as it is being told by me, O king, which destroys all impurities.
Śaṅkara and Pārvatī, competing with one another,
engaged in sexual union, O king, for fully a hundred years, it is said.
When there was no defeat of either of the two,
then the deities, distressed, spoke to one another:
'The embryo that will be born from this—the three worlds with all their moving and unmoving beings
will without doubt be bewitched by its splendour.
Therefore, O God of gods, consumer of oblations, enter into them.'
Addressed thus, the fire entered the best of gods.
Seeing him, the three-eyed god arose in agitation;
agitated by splendours, [his seed] then entered into the mouth of the fire.
The goddess Pārvatī cursed the gods: 'Upon your own wives,
defiled by my anger, you shall obtain no sons at all!'

1.182.d:
हुताशनोपि शर्वस्य दह्यमानो हि तेजसा ॥
तत्याज गर्भं गङ्गायां सापि कालेन केनचित् ॥ 8 ॥
तत्याज पर्वते श्वेते गर्भं वह्निसमप्रभम् ॥
तेन जातेन संवृत्तं सौवर्णं श्वेतपर्वतम् ॥ 9 ॥
सुवर्णरेतसस्तस्य शंकरस्य तु तेजसा ॥
ददृशुः कृत्तिका बालं संत्यक्तं तत्र गङ्गया ॥ 1.228.10 ॥
स्तनानि प्रददुस्तस्य कृपया राजसत्तम ॥
षडाननस्तदा भूत्वा षण्णामेव स्तनं पपौ ॥ 11 ॥
तासां क्षीरेण धर्मात्मा विवृद्धश्चारुतेजसा ॥
कृत्तिकानां वरं प्रादाद्यत्तद्वक्ष्यामि ते नृप ॥ 12 ॥
नाडायन उवाच ॥
यदा चन्द्रसमायोगं गमिष्यथ शुभाननाः ॥
तदा पूजां करिष्यंति भवतीनां तु ये नराः ॥ 13 ॥
वह्नेश्चन्द्रमसश्चैव वरुणस्य तथा मम ॥
गन्धमाल्यैस्तथा पुप्पैर्धूपैर्दीपैस्तथैव च ॥ 14 ॥
1.182.m:
The consumer of oblations, burning indeed from the splendour of Śarva,
deposited the embryo in the Gaṅgā, and she too after some time,
deposited on the White Mountain the embryo resembling fire in splendour.
Because it was born there, the White Mountain turned golden.
By the splendour of that Śaṅkara whose seed was gold,
the Kṛttikās beheld the boy abandoned there by the Gaṅgā.
Out of compassion, O best of kings, they offered their breasts to him.
Becoming six-faced, he then drank the breast of all six.
Grown through their milk, righteous in nature and of lovely splendour,
he granted a boon to the Kṛttikās, which I shall tell you, O king.
Nāḍāyana said:
'When you enter into conjunction with the moon, O fair-faced ones,
then whatever men will perform worship of you,
and of Fire, of the Moon, of Varuṇa, and of me,
with perfumes, garlands, flowers, incenses, and lamps;

with sacred perfumed water, parched grain, and honey,
with cakes, supreme porridge, and cow's curds;
with sour gruel, fruits, sweetmeats, modakas, and sweet drinks—
they will obtain their desired wishes in this world and the next.
And eating only at night, devoted to your worship,
after sporting for a very long time in heaven, he will be born in the human world,
endowed with beauty, devoted to truth, splendid, abiding in dharma, possessing many servants, / endowed with noble lineage and character, and his woman will be exceptionally fortunate.'
1.229
Nāḍāyana said:
Then the Gaṅgā went to where Kumāra, the son of Fire, was;
she said to him, the lord of the gods: 'You were brought forth by me, my son.
Unable to bear your great splendour on that best of mountains,
O Skanda, you who had entered my womb were abandoned then by me.'
Hearing those words of hers, the son of Fire spoke these words:
Skanda said:
'I will not go to your home; Śambhu is my divine father.

अनुग्रहं करिष्यामि तवाहं सुरनिम्नगे ॥
वैशाखमासशुक्लस्य तृतीयायां वरानने ॥ 4 ॥
मानुष्यमवतीर्णासि तदा पूजामवाप्स्यसि ॥
तमिन्नहनि यः स्नानमाचरिष्यति ते शुभे ॥ 5 ॥
राजसूयाश्वमेधाभ्यां फलेन स तु योक्ष्यति॥
तस्मिन्नहनि यः पूजां यत्र तत्र व्यवस्थितः ॥6॥
गन्धमाल्योपहाराद्यैर्धूपदीपान्नसंपदा ॥
कर्ता तव महाभागे त्वत्तोयस्नानजं फलम् ॥ 7 ॥
ध्रुवमाप्स्यति धर्मज्ञे नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
तस्मिन्नहनि यत्किञ्चित्प्रदद्याच्छ्रद्धयान्वितः ॥ 8 ॥
अक्षयं तत्फलं तस्य भविष्यति न संशयः ॥
अक्षया सा तिथिर्ज्ञेया कृत्तिकाभिर्युता यदि ॥ 9 ॥
भविष्यति महाभाग विशेषेण फलप्रदा ॥ 1.229.10 ॥
तस्मिन्दिने ये तव चारुगात्रि पूजां करिष्यंति तथेरितां प्राक् ॥
ते नाकलोके सुचिरं निरुप्य लोकान्गमिष्यन्ति जलाधिपस्य ॥ 11 ॥
1.182.m:
I shall grant a favor to you, O river of the gods:
on the third day of the bright fortnight of the month of Vaiśākha, O fair-faced one,
you descended to the human realm; then you will receive worship.
Whoever on that day performs a bath in you, O auspicious one,
he will attain the fruit of a Rājasūya and an Aśvamedha sacrifice. / Whoever, situated anywhere at all, on that day [performs] worship,
with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, offerings and the like, incense, lamps, and food, / [and] is an actor [of rituals] toward you, O fortunate one, the fruit born of bathing in your water
he will surely attain, O knower of dharma; there should be no doubt about this. / Whatever one gives on that day, endowed with faith,
that fruit of his will be inexhaustible; there is no doubt. / That lunar day is to be known as inexhaustible (Akṣayā); if joined with the Kṛttikās,
it will be, O highly fortunate one, exceptionally fruitful.
Those who, on that day, O lady of lovely limbs, will perform your worship as described before, / having dwelt for a very long time in heaven, will go to the worlds of the lord of waters.

नाडायन उवाच ॥
ततस्तु जातकर्माद्याः क्रियास्तस्य महात्मनः ॥
विश्वामित्रस्तु कृतवान्मङ्गलानि तथैव च ॥ 1 ॥
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु देवनाथाय वज्रिणे ॥
श्वेतजातमथाचख्युः कुमारं दीप्ततेजसम् ॥ 2 ॥
निधनाय मतिं चक्रे तदा तस्य पुरन्दरः ॥
दैवतैः पितृभिर्यज्ञैः प्रभुर्दानवराक्षसैः ॥ 3 ॥

संमन्त्र्य निधने तस्य सृष्टवान्स महाग्रहान् ॥ 4 ॥
देवदैत्यग्रहान्घोरान्पितृदानवराक्षसान् ॥
यक्षगन्धर्वनागानां नृणां च पिशिताशिनाम् ॥ 5 ॥
ते ग्रहा बहुसाहस्रा नानाप्रहरणोद्यताः ॥

1.182.m:
1.230 / Nāḍāyana said: / Then Viśvāmitra performed the birth rites and other rituals / for that great-souled one, and likewise auspicious ceremonies.
At that very time, [messengers] reported to the thunderbolt-wielder, the lord of the gods, / about the child of blazing splendour born on the white mountain.
Then Purandara set his mind on his destruction. / Together with the gods, ancestors, sacrifices, and the powerful Dānavas and Rākṣasas,
and with the Bhūtas, Nāgas, Piśācas, ancestors, Gandharvas, and humans, / having deliberated on his destruction, he created great seizing spirits (grahāḥ):
terrible seizing spirits of gods and Daityas, ancestors, Dānavas, and Rākṣasas, / of Yakṣas, Gandharvas, Nāgas, and flesh-eating mortals.
Those seizing spirits, many thousands in number, raising various weapons, / approached the white mountain with the desire to slay Kumāra.
Those seizing spirits were many thousands, and the auspicious Skanda / created seizing spirits by the hundreds, night-wanderers who were earlier spirits,
possessing great strength and great valour, moving at will, changing form at will, / many hundreds of thousands, in various garbs, swift as thought.

1.182.d:
नानारूपधरा वीरा नानाविविधवाससः ॥
प्रादुद्रवन्महान्घोरान्पूर्वदेवैर्विसर्जितान् ॥24॥
अविषह्यतमात्मानो ग्रहाः स्कन्दग्रहास्तथा ॥
स्कन्दं देववरं सर्वे तदा शरणमागताः ॥25॥
तांस्तु वै शरणं प्राप्तान्स्कंदो वचनमब्रवीत् ॥
स्कंद उवाच॥
शरणं वै प्रपन्नानां वरं दास्यामहं ग्रहाः ॥26॥
वरयध्वं यथाकामं पूज्या मे शरणार्थिनः ॥
ग्रहा ऊचुः ॥
भगवन्भक्षयिष्यामस्त्वत्प्रसादेन मानुषान् ॥27॥
एतद्वरमभीष्टं नः सर्वेषां दीप्तविग्रह ॥
स्कंद उवाच ॥
दुराचारांस्तथा लोके गन्धमाल्यानुलेपने॥28॥
तेषां शरीरे रत्यर्थं वसध्वं नात्र संशयः॥
ये भक्तास्त्र्यम्बके देवे तथा देवे जनार्दने॥29॥
आस्तिकाञ्छ्रद्धधानांश्च वर्जयध्वं प्रयत्नतः ॥
वरार्थमपि सङ्गृह्य न्यस्ता कर्मादिभिः क्रमः ॥ 1.230.30 ॥
1.182.m:
assuming various forms, heroic, dressed in various garments, / rushed against the great, terrible ones dispatched by the elder gods.
Those seizing spirits, of utterly irresistible nature, and the spirits of Skanda, / all then went for refuge to Skanda, the foremost of gods.
To those who had arrived for refuge, Skanda said this speech: / Skanda said: / 'I shall grant a boon to those who have resorted to me for refuge, O seizing spirits.
Choose according to your desire; those seeking refuge with me are to be honoured.' / The seizing spirits said: / 'O Lord, by your grace may we devour humans.
This is the desired boon of us all, O you of blazing form!' / Skanda said: / 'Those of evil conduct in the world, [who neglect] perfumes, garlands, and ointments,
dwell in their bodies for your pleasure, there is no doubt of this. / Those who are devoted to the god Tryambaka and to the god Janārdana,
and the faithful and believing, avoid with great effort. / Even taking hold of [men] for the sake of the boon, the proper order having been established according to deeds and the like,

1.182.d:
त्यक्षध्वं पुरुषाञ्शीघ्रं मम विज्ञाय शासनम् ॥
॥ नाडायन उवाच ॥
एवमुक्ता ग्रहाः सर्वे स्वाम्ये चक्रुस्तदा शिशुम् ॥ 31 ॥
कुमारं शर्वतनयं महाबलपराक्रमम् ॥
स्कन्देनैव यथोक्तं तु स्कन्दं स्कन्दग्रहास्तदा ॥ 32 ॥
समेता सर्वे वचनमिदमुचुर्नराधिप ॥
अस्माकमपि देवेश प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि ॥ 33 ॥
एवमुक्तोऽथ धर्मात्मा ग्रहा न्स्कन्दस्त्वभाषत ॥
यावत्षोडशवर्षाणि मानवानां भवन्त्युत ॥ 34 ॥
तावद्भवन्तो बाधन्तु मनुष्याणां तथा प्रजाः ॥
तत्रापि बलिकर्माद्यैः क्षेमं तेषां करिष्यथ ॥
ततः पूर्वं ग्रहाणां तु पूज्या लोके भविष्यथ ॥ 35 ॥
एतावदुक्त्वा भगवान्कुमारो ददौ ग्रहाणामपरं शरीरम् ॥
देहान्स्वकान्नायक उग्रसत्त्वो लोकस्य रक्षार्थमतीव हृष्टः ॥ 36 ॥
1.182.m:
you must quickly release the men, knowing my command.' / Nāḍāyana said: / Addressed thus, all the seizing spirits acknowledged the child as their master,
the youth, the son of Śarva, endowed with great strength and prowess. / Then, exactly as spoken by Skanda, the seizing spirits of Skanda
assembled together and spoke this word, O ruler of men: / 'O lord of gods, you should bestow your favour upon us as well.'
Addressed thus, the righteous Skanda spoke to the seizing spirits: / 'As long as the years of human beings are up to sixteen,
so long may you afflict the offspring of men. / Even then, through food offerings and the like you shall grant them peace; / prior to that, you will be worshipped in the world before the seizing spirits.'
Having said this, the blessed Kumāra gave to the seizing spirits another body; / the leader of fierce strength gave bodies of his own, exceedingly delighted, for the protection of the world.
